candidate_evidence.quote: a Phase 0, Open Label, PET/CT Molecular Imaging Basket Trial
VARTUTRACE uses two of these as radiolabeled antibody fragments to study biodistribution, tumor accumulation, pharmacodynamics and clearance pathways in a diverse patient population.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Anticipated diagnosis of a high-grade glioma (glioblastoma, grade 4 according to the WHO classification) based on imaging modalities such as MRI and/or CT or a biopsy.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Tumor-specific uptake of the IMP is captured using PET/CT imaging and quantified by calculating the tumor-to-background ratio (TBR)

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: The presence of the IMP and the oncofetal CS target in tumor tissue will be determined ex vivo and compared to the tracer signal measured in the tumor tissue in vivo.

role_evidence.quote: 89-Zirconium labeled short-chain variable fragment F8 targeting oncofetal CS.
VARTUTRACE is a Phase 0 microdosing study of a single administration of \<30 nmol of one of the two most promising antibody fragments identified by VAR2 Pharmaceuticals - C9 and F8.

coder_notes: Early Phase 1 (Phase 0) microdosing PET imaging basket trial; both 89Zr-labelled scFvs are given only as imaging tracers (single microdose, biodistribution/tumour uptake endpoints), so coded diagnostic_agent and no candidate. Tumour uptake by PET and ex vivo IMP presence in tissue are measured, but for a diagnostic tracer, not a candidate, so tumour_pk_planned and target_engagement_planned coded no. cns5_terminology: 'glioblastoma, grade 4 according to the WHO classification' without WHO edition or IDH requirement, coded unclear. Treatment setting inferred from 'Anticipated diagnosis' and neo-adjuvant SOC (pre-treatment newly diagnosed).
